workflows.name: Research Pipeline
workflows.description: Research a topic with adversarial validation. Unverified findings loop back for another pass; only confirmed findings reach the summary.

nodes.label: Research
nodes.description: Search external docs, APIs, libraries. Returns findings with source URLs.

nodes.label: Validate
nodes.description: Cross-check cited sources. Classify each claim as CONFIRMED/UNVERIFIED/CONTRADICTED.

nodes.label: Confirmed?
nodes.description: Are the findings backed by their cited sources?

nodes.label: Synthesize
nodes.description: Produce final summary using only CONFIRMED findings with citations.

workflows.name: Task Implementation
workflows.description: End-to-end implementation from a task description or Jira ticket. Failing tests come first, and failures loop back to implementation until green.

nodes.label: Requirements + Scan
nodes.description: Read the task or Jira ticket and survey the codebase

nodes.label: Plan
nodes.description: Break requirements into subtasks with complexity and dependency ordering

nodes.label: Research Gate
nodes.description: Only runs when a subtask uses unfamiliar APIs or libraries. Findings feed the implementer.

nodes.label: Approach Advisor
nodes.description: Medium-complexity subtasks only. Builder drafts an approach note, validator approves or asks for a revision, up to 3 rounds.

nodes.label: Failing Tests First
nodes.description: Write tests that encode the requirements and confirm they fail for the right reason

nodes.label: Implement
nodes.description: Execute each subtask. Low-complexity subtasks with no file overlap run in parallel builders.

nodes.label: Test
nodes.description: Run the suite, write missing unit and integration tests, and fix failures

nodes.label: Tests pass?
nodes.description: A plan-level failure returns to planning. Implementation failures return to implement.

nodes.label: Review
nodes.description: Three-lens review: requirements alignment, code quality, in-function optimization

nodes.label: Important findings?
nodes.description: Builder fixes important findings, then tests and review run again. Capped at 2 fix cycles.

workflows.name: Local Review
workflows.description: Self-review of uncommitted or unpushed work before opening a PR. A skeptic pass filters findings, then auto-fixable issues are offered as fixes.

nodes.label: Gather Context
nodes.description: Snapshot the diff, read requirements from the PR description, and build codebase context

nodes.label: Self-Review
nodes.description: One pass over codebase alignment, correctness and security, requirements, testability, and unfinished work

nodes.label: Skeptic Pass
nodes.description: Challenge each finding and confirm whether it is auto-fixable. Single pass, no loop.

nodes.label: Auto-fixable?
nodes.description: Are there important findings that are small, local, and unambiguous?

nodes.label: Apply Fixes
nodes.description: User picks which fixes to apply. Linter and typecheck rerun afterward.

nodes.label: Verdict
nodes.description: Ready to commit, or fix N important findings first

workflows.name: PR Review
workflows.description: Review someone else's PR against its description and the codebase. Large diffs fan out to four lens reviewers. Output stays local and nothing is posted to GitHub.

nodes.label: Gather Context
nodes.description: Fetch PR metadata and diff with gh, build the requirements document and codebase context

nodes.label: Over 500 lines?
nodes.description: Size gate on additions plus deletions

nodes.label: Single Reviewer
nodes.description: One agent applies all four lenses in one pass

nodes.label: Four Lens Reviewers
nodes.description: Codebase alignment, correctness and requirements, and security run in parallel. A tester covers testability.

nodes.label: Merge + Dedupe
nodes.description: Keep the highest severity per file and line, write findings_v1.json

nodes.label: Skeptic Pass
nodes.description: Verify each claim against codebase context and reject false positives. Single pass.

nodes.label: Local Report
nodes.description: Print the chat report, render a temporary HTML report, and save the findings JSON

workflows.name: Post PR Comments
workflows.description: Turns a review-pr findings file into a pending GitHub review. Each comment needs your approval, and nothing is visible to others until you submit the review.

nodes.label: Load Findings
nodes.description: Read the newest review-pr findings file and confirm it matches the PR

nodes.label: Filter
nodes.description: Drop non-actionable findings and comments already posted

nodes.label: Present One by One
nodes.description: Show each remaining finding for approval

nodes.label: Approved?
nodes.description: Skipped findings are dropped

nodes.label: Humanize
nodes.description: Rewrite approved text in the reviewer voice

nodes.label: Resolve Anchors
nodes.description: Map each finding to a line at the PR head commit

nodes.label: Post Pending Review
nodes.description: Create a pending review that only you can see until you submit it

workflows.name: Bug Fix with TDD
workflows.description: Make the broken behavior executable before touching production code. If no cheap test path exists, fall back to the closest executable check.

nodes.label: Understand Bug
nodes.description: Pin down intended behavior, current behavior, and the smallest reproduction

nodes.label: Cheap test path?
nodes.description: Skip a new test if it needs broad harness setup, brittle mocks, or slow infrastructure

nodes.label: Write Failing Test
nodes.description: Smallest focused test that would have caught the bug

nodes.label: Fails for right reason?
nodes.description: A test that passes, or fails for an unrelated reason, gets corrected first

nodes.label: Closest Check
nodes.description: Targeted script, manual reproduction, or focused integration check

nodes.label: Fix
nodes.description: Smallest production change that satisfies the intended behavior

nodes.label: Rerun Check
nodes.description: Confirm the regression test or fallback check now passes
